client.witness_view: Own records, optimizer/model state, openings and coins.
client.assumption: Local host is trusted for witness secrecy.

trusted-cluster.witness_view: Full assigned plaintext witnesses and intermediate computations.
trusted-cluster.assumption: Every worker and operator with plaintext access is trusted; transport must be authenticated/confidential.

outsourced-prover.witness_view: Full supplied witness, openings, private model and intermediate values.
outsourced-prover.assumption: Ordinary prover is trusted with plaintext; final ZK does not hide its inputs from it.

collaborative-prover.witness_view: Protocol-specified shares and authorized leakage, not assumed plaintext secrecy.
collaborative-prover.assumption: Selected MPC/proving protocol, authenticated channels and a proved collusion threshold are required.

attested-prover.witness_view: Plaintext inside the measured TEE; host-visible metadata and stated leakage.
attested-prover.assumption: Verified measurement/attestation, provisioning, anti-rollback, trusted hardware and side-channel model.

coordinator.witness_view: M0 clean updates, public policy/transcript, all synthetic inputs; proposed central sampler sees clean query.
coordinator.assumption: Trusted for central DP against public observer; aggregate confidentiality is unsupported in M0.

committee.assumption: Authenticated honest-quorum/collusion and availability assumptions; no committee implementation yet.

telemetry.witness_view: Only fixed coarse public events; no witnesses, coins, paths or exception payloads.
telemetry.assumption: Exporter allowlist plus independent review of backend/worker/crash telemetry.

artifact-store.witness_view: Reviewed public JSON/reports and public identifiers; source fixtures are explicitly synthetic.
artifact-store.assumption: CI-10 public-tree/schema checks, exact artifact regeneration and human narrative review.

flows.protection: Ordinary remote proving; authenticated transport required

flows.assumption: No secrecy until protocol/collusion theorem is supplied.
Verify exact code/hardware/key provisioning before release.

flows.data: M0 individual updates; proposed central-DP inputs
flows.assumption: Coordinator sees clean contributions/query; no privacy against it.
Quorum honesty and certificate availability are distinct assumptions.
No raw exception or arbitrary worker log may cross this boundary.

flows.data: Approved public event and schema-valid reports
flows.protection: Closed public schema and exact report regeneration
flows.assumption: Known-canary test does not establish complete noninterference.

limitations: Synthetic reference surface audit only; no live distributed/proving deployment.
Source fixtures intentionally include canary definitions; no actual private input is used.
Timing, OS/subprocess logs, crash dumps, encoded leaks and malicious callbacks remain outside coverage.
